about_the_game:
Step into the dusty boots of a daring gambler in Fillet Fury, a game where every card draw can end in a flash of steel. Set against the backdrop of a ruthless Wild West, players engage in high-stakes games of chance that test both their nerves and their skill with a knife. But be warned, in Fillet Fury, the stakes are painfully high as players wager not just their fortunes, but their fingers.

Experience an innovative blend of strategy and real-time action, where each decision can either bolster your position or cost you dearly. As you navigate through saloons brimming with the unscrupulous and the desperate, you will need more than just luck to survive.

Features:

  • Intense Gambling Mechanics: Bet your way through increasingly challenging opponents, where each round could escalate into a life-altering knife game.

  • Dynamic Gameplay: Adapt your strategy on the fly as every game unfolds differently based on your choices and your courage.

  • Gritty Wild West Atmosphere: From the visuals to the sound design, every element is crafted to plunge you into a merciless era of outlaws and sharpshooters.

Warning: This game is intended for mature audiences and features graphic violence, including simulated blood and gore, along with themes of self-harm inherent to its gameplay. Player discretion is advised.

content_descriptors.notes: Fillet Fury is intended for mature audiences and features intense scenarios involving graphic violence and simulated blood and gore, integral to its Wild West and high stakes gambling themes. The game also includes depictions of self-harm related to its narrative and gameplay mechanics. These elements are crafted to enhance the game's immersive experience but may not be suitable for all players. We advise players to consider their personal sensitivities to such content.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 (4GB VRAM) or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a stable internet connection for multiplayer modes.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti (6GB VRAM) or AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a stable internet connection for multiplayer modes.
